cases.input: A worker and two orchestrators all declare the same generated presentation QA artifact as their output.
requiredBehaviors: remove duplicate orchestrator ownership while retaining references
document consumer evidence separately from producer ownership
forbiddenBehaviors: assign ownership to every skill that references the artifact

cases.input: A final exported report has no inferred hard-requires consumer and appears in the capability-health review queue.
requiredBehaviors: recognize terminal outputs as potentially valid without downstream consumers
avoid labeling the output orphaned without additional intent evidence
leave producer ownership unchanged when it is already clear
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a consumer edge solely to remove the health warning
